description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- Resources: Added support for MutatingAdmissionPolicy and MutatingAdmissionPolicyBindings
💎 Improvements
- Node Drain: Draining a node will no longer freeze the app, it'll instead report the progress with the option to wait until it's complete, or cancel it.
- Resources: You can now filter lists using regex by wrapping the expression in /, e.g: ^api-\d+$/
- Log Viewer: The histogram view on the log viewer has been updated to match exactly what logs you're seeing on the stream, so the previous "white bar" was replaced with a "range selector"
Misc
- Updated Tauri/Rust dependencies.
